defects.what: City row text (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Kolkata) renders far darker than the specified #B8B8B8 — appears roughly #3A3A3A–#4A4A4A on the #0C0C0C sheet, well below the 4.5:1 AA threshold. The primary decision content of the sheet is nearly unreadable.
defects.where: All seven city rows in the sheet body

defects.what: 'I will choose later' link is barely visible — reads much darker than the specified #8C8C8C (est. ~#333333 on #0C0C0C, ~1.5–2:1). It is the sheet's escape action and effectively a dead end if unreadable.

Row text appears vertically clipped: 'Delhi', 'Mumbai', 'Bengaluru', 'Hyderabad', 'Ahmedabad', 'Chennai', 'Kolkata' all show cut-off descenders/bottom edges, as if the label is cropped at the row's baseline. Content the patient needs to decide is not fully rendered.

Sheet edge separation from scrim is weak — the #0C0C0C sheet against the near-black background/scrim reads as almost no visible boundary; the top corners of the sheet are only faintly distinguishable.
defects.where: Top edge of the bottom sheet

measured_notes: City row labels estimated at ~16px but at very low contrast (~2:1 or below by eye), failing AA 4.5:1 against the dark sheet.
'I will choose later' estimated ~14–15px, contrast well under 4.5:1 on #0C0C0C.
'Skip' (top right) is mid-grey on near-black, roughly 4–5:1 — borderline but the least alarming text on screen.
Row pitch looks ~53px with row text boxes around 44px height — touch targets appear compliant.
Sheet left/right gutters appear ~16px with 12px-ish internal spacing; radius on sheet top corners looks consistent (~16px).
Grab handle visible at sheet top center, dark grey (#262626-ish) — present but extremely low visibility against the sheet.
City labels show visible bottom clipping on all seven rows (descenders cut).
non_blocking_notes: Header 'Your city' (white, bold ~20px) and subtitle (light grey) read first and clear — hierarchy by scale is respected.
Illustration pin/teal accent dot is visible and uses the single teal accent appropriately.
Row icons (location pins) are slightly brighter than row text — inconsistent text/icon grey levels within rows.
No scrim tap target or scrim dimming visibly distinguishable behind the sheet — worth verifying interaction exists even if visually subtle.
one_line: The sheet's structure, spacing and hierarchy are right, but nearly all row text and the 'choose later' link fail dark-mode contrast and appear baseline-clipped, making the core decision content unreadable — blocking.
